objective_value: <float> Total tour completion time, equal to the moment the later of the truck and drone returns to the depot.
truck_route: <list[int], length varies> Ordered sequence of node identifiers visited by the truck, starting at the depot and ending at the depot.
drone_route: <list[int], length varies> Ordered sequence of node identifiers visited by the drone, starting at the depot and ending at the depot.
customer_types: <dict, key: '{customer_id}'> Service type assigned to each customer, valued 'truck' if served by the truck alone, 'drone' if served by the drone alone, or 'combined' if both vehicles meet at that customer.
arrival_times: <dict, key: '{node_id}'> Time at which service begins at each node, where node 0 is the depot origin, nodes 1..num_customers are the customers, and node num_customers+1 is the depot destination whose value equals the tour completion time.
